exchangeRates.title: Exchange rates
exchangeRates.description: Set your own rate for a currency pair on a given day, for a currency the rate feed does not cover or a day it got wrong. Everyone in a household shares these rates.
exchangeRates.how-it-applies: A rate applies from its day until the feed, or another of your rates, has a newer one. On its own day it replaces the feed's rate. Amounts already stored are converted again in the background.
exchangeRates.empty: No exchange rates of your own yet. Conversions use the rate feed.
exchangeRates.load-error: Your exchange rates could not be loaded.
exchangeRates.currencies-load-error: The currency list could not be loaded.
exchangeRates.save-error: The rate could not be saved.
exchangeRates.created: Rate added. Amounts are being converted again.
exchangeRates.updated: Rate updated. Amounts are being converted again.
exchangeRates.deleted: Rate deleted. Amounts are being converted again.
exchangeRates.delete-description: Conversions that used it go back to the rate feed, or show as not converted when the feed has no rate for this pair.

errors.date-future: The day cannot be in the future.
errors.rate-invalid: Enter a rate greater than zero.
errors.exists: You already have a rate for this pair on this day. Edit that one instead.
